service.en: Register or renew a tenancy contract (Ejari)
service.ur: کرایہ نامے کی رجسٹریشن یا تجدید (ایجاری)

about: Register a new tenancy contract in Dubai or renew an existing one.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Register or renew a tenancy contract (Ejari). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: At a trustee centre the applicant must be the tenant or hold an official power of attorney
At a trustee centre the property must not be run by a management company or an owner with Ejari access
Through the app the tenant and landlord must both be individuals with up-to-date owner data
documents: Copy of the Unified Tenancy Contract for the app
Original Unified Tenancy Contract at a trustee centre
Emirates ID of the applicant at a trustee centre
Power of attorney if a representative applies; one issued outside Dubai must be attached
fees: AED 177.75 in total through the Dubai REST app or DLD website
AED 220 in total at a Real Estate Services Trustee Centre
timing: 25 minutes at a trustee centre, not counting waiting
channels: a Real Estate Services Trustee Centre
